newsitem.title: USA: SAFECO sees Q4 off $0.18/shr from storms.
newsitem.headline: SAFECO sees Q4 off $0.18/shr from storms.

text.p: SAFECO Corp said it expects claims from winter storms that struck the Puget Sound area in late December to reduce fourth quarter earnings by about $0.18 a share.

SAFECO said it expects about $35 million in claims from the winter storms and said 7,000 claims have been reported so far. These claims involve damage from the weight of snow, fallen trees and water, the company said.
Claims from the recent storms in Nevada, northern California and Oregon are not expected to be significant, SAFECO said.
SAFECO said it will report its fourth quarter earnings on Jan. 17.
